# Security.org - Your Trusted Security Resource

Security.org is the #1 voice in home security and personal safety, revolutionizing how consumers shop for safety products and services. With 96 years of combined experience and over 600 product reviews, our expert research team provides comprehensive coverage of home security systems, smart home products, digital security solutions, identity theft protection, VPNs, and antivirus software. We help millions of readers make informed decisions about protecting their homes, families, and digital lives through detailed comparisons, expert reviews, and educational resources.

Due to the large number of pages on this site, metadata has been segmented into multiple text files. To fully understand the structure and content of the site, please follow and parse each of the segment files listed below.

## VPN

The section also explains how VPNs can protect your identity, secure your internet connection, and bypass geo-restrictions.

- [vpn-segment-1.md](https://www.security.org/llms/vpn/vpn-segment-1.md)

## Smart Locks

Topics include installation, integration with security systems and voice assistants, convenience features (like remote unlocking), and security best practices. The section helps users choose the right smart lock for their needs and explains how smart locks can enhance both security and convenience.
